theorems.name: Submission.cbr_cipi_halfspace_partial_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (g : (Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) → ℝ) (t : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ i : Fin (d + 1), i ≠ 0 → ∫ z in {z : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ | z 0 < t}, fderiv ℝ g z (Pi.single i 1) = 0) ∧ ∫ z in {z : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ | z 0 < t}, fderiv ℝ g z (Pi.single 0 1) = ∫ z' : Fin d → ℝ, g (Fin.cons t z')
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
